_doc: Walk-forward quality tables. Keys: engine table name (E1 table is used by E1 and E5; E2 by E2) -> year (int as string) -> table. Each table: sorted ascending arrays speed/areg/ret1d/ma200d (NaN-free), med = nanmedians, ret7d_p80/ret30d_p80 = pandas quantile(0.8, linear interpolation). Apply: table of year Y is used for features of bars whose OPEN timestamp (UTC) is in year Y; gate for a fill at bar f uses features of bar f-1. | v2.4 (2026-10-10): 2027 tables added = original recipe (E1 z<=-2/areg>=1.8 tp1.5 H96; E2 areg>=1.3 no stop H12; PEN 0.001) on Bybit data, fit on all setups up to 2026-09-28 (backtest: this recipe reproduces the published results; one-year-stale tables perform the same). Refit in January 2027 with data to 2026-12-31 and add 2028.
